name: dumbbell rotational grip bench press
description: A dumbbell bench press where your grip rotates during the press. It adds a smooth, shoulder-friendly path for the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing each other.
Press the weights up while turning your palms to face forward.
Reach full arm extension over your chest.
Lower the weights while rotating back to a neutral grip.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades tight.
